log.raw: {"understanding":{"purpose":"Connect each incident and its trace identifier with its severity and a prose summary.","tasks":["Look up an incident or trace ID and find the corresponding severity and summary.","Compare severity and incident details across rows.","Read each summary in sequence to understand what happened."],"relations":["Each row describes one incident; its trace ID identifies the associated trace, while severity and summary describe the incident.","The incident ID and trace ID are exact identifiers whose characters and row association matter."],"roles":["The header names the four fields; each body row is one record.","Incident and Trace ID support lookup, Severity supports scanning and comparison, and Summary supplies explanatory prose."],"keep_whole":["Incident IDs and trace IDs should remain whole whenever space permits.","Severity values and individual words should remain whole when possible."],"may_wrap":["Summary prose can wrap naturally between words.","Incident and trace IDs may have to split in a viewport-fitting design."],"same_scale":["All body rows should have a consistent column structure.","Identifier columns deserve enough space for reliable reading; the prose column can use a different scale because it contains sentences."],"h_vs_v":"At 360px, preserving both identifiers requires horizontal scrolling. More width for the summary reduces row height but places more of the table beyond the initial viewport; fitting the viewport avoids scrolling at the cost of split identifiers and taller rows."},"designs":[{"widths":[90,100,80,89],"strategy":"Fit the viewport, preserving severity while distributing the remaining space among identifiers and summary, accepting breaks inside long identifiers and some summary words."},{"widths":[165,299,80,180],"strategy":"Use a compact scrolling table that keeps identifiers and severity whole while wrapping summaries into relatively narrow blocks."},{"widths":[165,299,80,420],"strategy":"Use a wide scrolling table that keeps identifiers whole and gives summary prose ample space for continuous reading and shorter rows."}]}
